PLATFORM_ROLES_ADMIN.name: Platform Roles Admin
PLATFORM_ROLES_ADMIN.owns: Role assignment and nothing else: assigns and revokes all 14 roles (sole authority for the Platform ones), reads every holder list, sets the service-profile marker.
PLATFORM_ROLES_ADMIN.mustNot: Any content, settings, operational or user-record action; reading the audit trail; assigning any role to ITSELF.

PLATFORM_CONTENT_FULL_ACCESS.name: Platform Content Full Access
PLATFORM_CONTENT_FULL_ACCESS.owns: Full create / read / update / delete on all platform content. By the single accepted exception it also deletes an organization and edits an organization's packs, hubs and templates.
PLATFORM_CONTENT_FULL_ACCESS.mustNot: Role assignment - absolutely, itself included; settings; operations; user records; resource moves; the forum; space visibility; entity renames.

PLATFORM_RESOURCE_ADMIN.name: Platform Resource Admin
PLATFORM_RESOURCE_ADMIN.owns: Resource moves: a space, hub, pack or VC to another account; promote, demote or move a space; move a callout or a contribution. Also sets a callout's publisher information (A8 `updateCalloutPublishInfo`, shared with Content Full Access - operator amendment 2026-10-07).
PLATFORM_RESOURCE_ADMIN.mustNot: Everything else - role assignment, settings, operations, user records, content access, the forum, support.

PLATFORM_SETTINGS_ADMIN.name: Platform Settings Admin
PLATFORM_SETTINGS_ADMIN.owns: Platform settings and configuration; DEFINING license plans and their entitlement rules.
PLATFORM_SETTINGS_ADMIN.mustNot: USING licenses (that is License Manager); role assignment; content; operations; user records.

PLATFORM_OPERATIONS_ADMIN.name: Platform Operations Admin
PLATFORM_OPERATIONS_ADMIN.owns: Operational machinery: authorization and license resets, search and AI re-ingest, migrations, notification prune, Matrix housekeeping.
PLATFORM_OPERATIONS_ADMIN.mustNot: Reading user personal data; email change or identity deletion; role assignment; content; settings; space visibility or structure.

PLATFORM_USERS_ADMIN.name: Platform Users Admin
PLATFORM_USERS_ADMIN.owns: User records: login email change, user / identity / account deletion, users' MCP keys. Assigns the FEATURE roles and reads their holder lists.
PLATFORM_USERS_ADMIN.mustNot: Assigning PLATFORM roles; reading Platform holder lists; the audit trail; content; settings; authorization reset.

PLATFORM_SUPPORT.name: Platform Support
PLATFORM_SUPPORT.owns: The organization lifecycle (create and delete); editing an organization's packs, hubs and the templates inside; managing an organisation's people on its Community tab (invite, promote/demote, remove, approve/reject, revoke, resend), by consent only; the platform forum; admin rights inside a space ONLY where that space enables the support flag.
PLATFORM_SUPPORT.mustNot: Moving those resources; deleting the pack or hub itself; any space that has not enabled the flag; platform role assignment; adding anyone to an organisation directly; any other organisation settings; operations; user records.

PLATFORM_LICENSE_MANAGER.name: Platform License Manager
PLATFORM_LICENSE_MANAGER.owns: License usage: assigns and revokes plans on accounts and spaces, sets the baseline plan, changes space visibility.
PLATFORM_LICENSE_MANAGER.mustNot: Defining plans (that is Settings Admin); everything else.

PLATFORM_SPACES_READER.name: Platform Spaces Reader
PLATFORM_SPACES_READER.owns: Reads across all spaces. Service accounts only - a grant to a human is rejected.

PLATFORM_AUDIT_READER.name: Platform Audit Reader
PLATFORM_AUDIT_READER.owns: Reads the platform audit trail (the only role that may) and every holder list.
PLATFORM_AUDIT_READER.mustNot: EVERY administrative action - it performs none, so it can never review its own work. Mutually exclusive with every other Platform role.

FEATURE_BETA_TESTER.name: Feature Beta Tester
FEATURE_BETA_TESTER.owns: Carries the trial license entitlement. Owns no administrative capability.
FEATURE_BETA_TESTER.mustNot: Every administrative capability - including creating organizations, which moved to Feature Organization Creator.

FEATURE_VIRTUAL_ASSISTANT.name: Feature Virtual Assistant
FEATURE_VIRTUAL_ASSISTANT.owns: Access to the virtual assistant. Owns no administrative capability.

FEATURE_ORGANIZATION_CREATOR.name: Feature Organization Creator
FEATURE_ORGANIZATION_CREATOR.mustNot: Deleting organizations (that is Platform Support); every other administrative capability.

FEATURE_VC_CAMPAIGN.name: Feature VC Campaign
FEATURE_VC_CAMPAIGN.owns: Shown the dashboard Virtual Contributor offer; carries the trial entitlement. Owns no administrative capability.
